paper_limits: This is continuation of previously trained cores, not fresh-data-only causality or from-scratch training
Seed0 selection and paired-image confidence intervals do not establish seed-population generalization
RGB consistency can merge same-colored objects or fragment textured backgrounds; STE is not the true derivative of hard connected components

Finite gradients and FG improvement do not establish meaningful forward causal contribution of membrane, dendritic retention or binary events; repeat registered frozen causal interventions on any promoted model separately
A 4096-image pilot cannot establish data scaling; unique-image effects require a later fixed-update/exposure, matched nested-data comparison distinct from extra training updates
